acceptanceCriteria: Reproduce or bound the race (e.g. run with -count=200 under CPU load), and record the outcome.
If confirmed: the producer acquisition is synchronized with the observer (barrier or fifo), so the test cannot miss the window. The fix is verified with a repeated run under load.
If not reproducible: the ticket is closed with the evidence, and the CI failure attributed elsewhere.
body:
Suspected flaky test (not yet confirmed as a defect). Observed 2026-10-01 in CI on beamfall/corvint#434 (head 0bce80fe, run 36914793900, job go-product-shard (1)):

    work_materialization_unix_test.go:189: actual producer did not acquire scratch under observer ownership
    --- FAIL: TestWorkActualProducerInterruptedScratchCleanup (2.18s)

#434 changes only internal/tasks/dispatch and docs; this test (cmd/corvint) is unchanged since the public snapshot.

Hypothesis: the poll loop in cmd/corvint/work_materialization_unix_test.go (~lines 156-180) globs `corvint-work-source-*` every millisecond and SIGSTOPs the group once a path appears. A fast producer can create and remove its scratch directory between polls and exit, so `acquired` stays empty. The comment there already names the race with a normally completed short acquisition; the loop narrows it but cannot close it.

Expected: the test deterministically observes the producer holding scratch (e.g. the producer blocks on a test-controlled barrier or fifo after acquisition), or it records a skip-with-reason when the window was missed. It should never fail on timing.

Actual: an intermittent FAIL on a loaded hosted runner. The failed jobs were re-run.
title: Suspected flake: TestWorkActualProducerInterruptedScratchCleanup can miss the producer's scratch window
